sources.label: Pet Simulator Wiki - List of Machines (Pet Simulator 99)
Pet Simulator 99 Wiki - List of Areas

notes: Final dataset uses the approved 32-row core/action scope.
The 27 vending machine rows from the source table are intentionally excluded from default cards and should be summarized in page copy.
Evolve Machine is included as a stable endgame conversion station with irreversible cost context.
Combine-O-Matic is included as an edge row with limited/event-origin availability context and no recipe list.
Images are intentionally blank until clean station icons or screenshots are gathered locally.

items.name: Pet Box
items.description: Pet Box is the first transfer station players see, used for claiming pets brought over from Pet Simulator X.
items.verificationNote: Name, use, and location from the main machine list.

items.name: Garg Machine (Huge-A-Tron)
items.task: Create Huge or Gargantuan machine eggs
items.inputCost: Small Exclusive pets or listed machine requirements
items.output: Huge Egg or refreshed Gargantuan Machine reward pool
items.unlockAvailability: Castle machine; reward lineup can refresh
items.warning: Consumes valuable Exclusive pets or machine inputs.
items.description: Garg Machine, also known through Huge-A-Tron context, is an expensive pet-conversion station for chasing bigger exclusive rewards.
items.verificationNote: Main list identifies the Castle Huge-A-Tron use; BIG Games Update 77 confirms Gargantuan Machine refresh behavior.

items.name: Pets Equipped
items.inputCost: Upgrade cost shown at the machine
items.description: Pets Equipped is a core team-size station, useful as soon as stronger farming depends on having more pets active.
items.verificationNote: Name, use, and location from the main machine list.

items.name: Egg Machine
items.inputCost: Upgrade cost shown at the machine
items.description: Egg Machine helps hatching sessions scale by raising how many eggs a player can open at once.
items.verificationNote: Name, use, and location from the main machine list.

items.name: Gold Pets Machine
items.location: Area #10 - Mine; also available from Tech Spawn machine hub context
items.description: Gold Pets Machine turns normal pets into gold versions, making it one of the first major pet-upgrade stops.
items.verificationNote: Main list gives Mine location; Update 77 confirms current Gold/Rainbow machine behavior through bug-fix notes.

items.name: Fuse Machine
items.description: Fuse Machine is for turning extra pets into a new pet result instead of keeping every duplicate in inventory.
items.verificationNote: Name, use, and location from the main machine list.

items.name: Rainbow Machine
items.location: Area #31 - Desert Pyramids; also available from Tech Spawn machine hub context
items.inputCost: Gold pets selected for rainbow conversion
items.description: Rainbow Machine is the next pet-upgrade step after gold, turning gold pets into stronger rainbow versions.
items.verificationNote: Main list gives Desert Pyramids location; Update 77 confirms current Gold/Rainbow machine behavior through bug-fix notes.

items.name: Evolve Machine
items.task: Convert Huge pets into evolved variants
items.warning: Evolution cannot be undone and the Huge pets used are gone.
items.description: Evolve Machine is for endgame players who want evolved Huge variants and the Exclusive Daycare diamond bonus, not a casual pet upgrade.
items.verificationNote: Individual page and BIG Games Update 36 confirm 5-Huge cost, irreversible conversion, and 1.5x Exclusive Daycare diamond context.

items.name: Card Combination Machine
items.description: Card Combination Machine handles card-to-pet conversion without needing a normal area-station stop.
items.verificationNote: Name, use, and location from the main machine list.

items.name: Upgrade Potions Machine
items.description: Upgrade Potions Machine turns lower potion tiers into stronger ones, which also makes spare low-tier boosts useful later.
items.verificationNote: Location from main list; exact high-tier costs intentionally left to potion catalog/in-game machine because source tables can conflict.

items.name: Upgrade Enchants Machine
items.inputCost: Lower-tier enchant books and machine cost
items.description: Upgrade Enchants Machine is the normal route for pushing tiered enchant books into stronger versions.
items.verificationNote: Location from main list; ties to tiered enchant upgrade behavior.

items.name: Upgrade Fruits Machine
items.description: Upgrade Fruits Machine is the fruit-blending station for turning regular fruit stacks into stronger fruit variants.
items.verificationNote: Main list and BIG Games Update 1 confirm fruit machine context around Bamboo Forest.

items.name: Magic Machine
items.description: Magic Machine spends magic materials for selected crafted items after players reach Haunted Mansion.
items.verificationNote: Name, use, and location from the main machine list.

items.name: Item Creator
items.inputCost: Quest progress or listed item requirements
items.description: Item Creator turns quest work into items, so it belongs with crafting stations rather than normal pet machines.
items.verificationNote: Name, use, and location from the main machine list.

items.name: Forge Machine
items.description: Forge Machine is a later item-combination station for turning eligible materials into parent items.
items.verificationNote: Name, use, and location from the main machine list.

items.name: Empower Enchants
items.description: Empower Enchants is a short-session boost station for books you already plan to use.
items.verificationNote: Main machine list confirms 8-hour empower behavior and location.

items.name: Enchant Essence
items.description: Enchant Essence converts books into the essence used by the empower system.
items.verificationNote: Main machine list confirms book-to-essence behavior and location.

items.name: XP Potion Machine
items.inputCost: Recipe ingredients shown at the machine
items.output: Ultimate, Mastery, Huge, or Titanic XP potions
items.description: XP Potion Machine creates direct-progress potions for expensive targets such as Huge pets, Titanic pets, masteries, and ultimates.
items.verificationNote: Main machine list confirms XP potion targets and location.

items.name: Prison P (Prison Preston)
items.description: Prison Preston is a key-conversion station tied to the Prison area route.
items.verificationNote: Name, use, and location from the main machine list.

items.name: Seashell Machine
items.description: Seashell Machine is a gift-crafting station for turning seashell resources into Summer Gifts.
items.verificationNote: Name, use, and location from the main machine list.

items.name: Combine-O-Matic
items.location: Event worlds and Fantasy World contexts
items.inputCost: Event or world items listed by the active machine
items.output: Higher-tier items, Huge pets, Titanic pets, or Gargantuan pets
items.warning: Recipes change by event and should not be treated as permanent.
items.description: Combine-O-Matic is a recurring limited crafting station, so the row tracks the machine role without turning old recipes into permanent card text.
items.verificationNote: Included as approved edge row with limited/event-origin context and no recipe-track expansion.

items.name: Daycare
items.inputCost: Pets enrolled for a daycare timer
items.description: Daycare turns unused pets into timed reward runs while they are enrolled.
items.verificationNote: Name, use, and location from the main machine list.

items.name: Comet Shower Machine
items.output: Comet Shower event in an area
items.description: Comet Shower Machine starts a comet event when players want a burst of breakable-style rewards.
items.verificationNote: Name, use, and location from the main machine list.

items.name: Quest Machines
items.location: Area #29 - Desert Village; Area #60 - Rainbow River; Area #111 - Oasis Ruins
items.inputCost: Daily, 3 Day, or Weekly quest work
items.description: Quest Machines group daily, 3 Day, and weekly quest boards into one route-focused row so players can find the board they need.
items.verificationNote: Collapsed three quest-board variants into one row to avoid duplicate cards.

items.name: Exclusive Daycare
items.task: Earn diamonds from Huge and Titanic pets
items.inputCost: Huge and Titanic pets inserted into Exclusive Daycare
items.warning: Only commit valuable pets when you understand the daycare timer and payoff.
items.description: Exclusive Daycare is a late-game diamond station for players who can spare Huge or Titanic pets for reward time.
items.verificationNote: Main list gives location/use; Evolve Machine page confirms Exclusive Daycare diamond bonus relevance for evolved pets.

items.name: Area Surge
items.inputCost: Machine activation requirement shown in game
items.description: Area Surge is a coin-focused boost station for charging an area when currency farming is the goal.
items.verificationNote: Individual page confirms Area 177 and 5x coin boost behavior.

items.name: Boost Exchange
items.output: Diamond, drop chance, and egg luck boost time
items.description: Boost Exchange spends Millionaire Bucks for temporary farming and hatching boosts after players reach Silver City.
items.verificationNote: Individual page confirms Bucks-to-boost behavior, boost types, and 24-hour per-boost cap.

items.name: Trainer Preston
items.description: Trainer Preston is a quest station tied to catching pets rather than crafting or converting inventory items.
items.verificationNote: Name, use, and location from the main machine list.

items.name: Wings Upgrade
items.inputCost: Wing upgrade requirement shown in game
items.description: Wings Upgrade is a world-specific progression station for improving the wings system.
items.verificationNote: Name, use, and location from the main machine list.

items.name: Woodcutting Preston
items.description: Woodcutting Preston is a quest station for the woodcutting route in later Elemental progression.
items.verificationNote: Name, use, and location from the main machine list.

items.name: Index Machine
items.location: Area #1 - Spawn; Area #76 - Haunted Graveyard; Tech Spawn context
items.description: Index Machine is a collection-management stop for checking how many different pets a player has collected.
items.verificationNote: Main list gives source locations; Update 77 mentions current Index Machine behavior through bug-fix notes.

items.name: Super Computer
items.location: Trading Plaza; Area #100 - Tech Spawn; Void Spawn; Area #240 - Fantasy Spawn
items.inputCost: Area or rebirth access; Trading Plaza requires Rebirth 4 and Void Spawn requires Rebirth 8
items.output: Machine access across World 1, World 2, World 3, and Fantasy context
items.description: Super Computer is the main machine hub, useful when players want machine access without walking back through older worlds.
items.verificationNote: Main list gives access points and rebirth notes; Update 77 confirms Trading Terminal was added to the Super Computer.
